project.name: Out
project.tagline: Everything happening near you. One place. Always free.

vision: A free mobile-first app that aggregates local events, hobby groups, sports leagues, and community gatherings into one Instagram-style feed. AI agents handle content scraping and verification. Louisville, KY launch city.
current_priorities: Move to Claude Code for agent layer

architecture_decisions.decision: Start in Lovable for UI, move to Claude Code for agent layer
architecture_decisions.reason: Faster UI iteration in Lovable, Claude Code better for complex backend logic

Monetization model if any — keep fully free or freemium for organizers

backlog: Build event scraping agent for Eventbrite

blockers: Need to finalize database choice before building backend
